# cursor Provider

Manage Cursor Automations and Enterprise team administration settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cursor = {
      source  = "cursor/cursor"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "cursor" {
	# Each value can also be supplied through its CURSOR_* environment variable.
	token        = var.cursor_token
	team_api_key = var.cursor_team_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Cursor API base URL. Defaults to https://api2.cursor.sh. Can also be set via CURSOR_ENDPOINT.
- `team_api_endpoint` (String) Cursor Team Admin API base URL. Defaults to https://api.cursor.com. Can also be set via CURSOR_TEAM_API_ENDPOINT.
- `team_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Team Admin API key used for per-user spend limits. Can also be set via CURSOR_TEAM_API_KEY.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Auth token for the Cursor API. Can also be set via CURSOR_TOKEN.
